project_name: DevOps Institute - AWS, Azure & GCP Course Mumbai

theme_strategy.direction: Simple, Clean, Trustworthy & High-Conversion Swiss Light Theme
theme_strategy.rationale: Client rejected the previous dark navy terminal look (#0A192F). The new direction uses crisp bone/white background (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF), authoritative Royal Blue (#1E40AF) for brand confidence, Vivid Blue (#2563EB) for interactive elements, and High-Trust Emerald Green (#10B981) for placement stats and badges. Designed for maximum readability, fast mobile loading, and instant conversion within 5 seconds.
theme_strategy.primary_focus: Local SEO, Mobile Responsiveness, 4-Month Career Outcome, Classroom + Placement Trust Signals

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.15]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-normal
hierarchy.badge_label: text-xs uppercase font-bold tracking-widest text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-blue-200

spacing_and_layout.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:border-blue-300 transition-all duration-200
spacing_and_layout.hero_layout: Clean split grid: Left 60% high-conversion copy + bullet trust points + direct enquiry CTA form trigger; Right 40% crisp campus photo frame with floating placement success card.
spacing_and_layout.navigation_bar: Sticky top bar with zero transparency glitches: `sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 shadow-xs`. Includes quick contact details and prominent 'Book Free Demo Class' primary CTA.

header.style: Clean white header with Blue infinity logo, key nav links (AWS, Azure, GCP, Placements, Campus, Contact), phone click-to-call link (+91 98200 12345), and 'Enquire Now' button.
header.mobile_nav: Slide-out drawer with direct phone, WhatsApp, and course quick links.

hero_section.value_prop_h1: Become a Certified DevOps Engineer in 4 Months
hero_section.sub_text: 100% Practical Classroom Training in Powai & Chandivali, Mumbai. Weekend & Weekday Batches with Dedicated Placement Support.

course_cards_grid.structure: 3x2 grid with clear blue tags for Duration, Mode (Classroom), and Placement Guarantee badge.
card_features: Icon/Logo for Cloud Provider (AWS / Azure / GCP / Kubernetes / Linux / Terraform)
Key skills covered & salary potential callout
View Details CTA + Quick Enquiry Modal launcher

campus_video_reels.structure: 3-column vertical reel layout (9:16 aspect ratio cards) showing campus environment, lab sessions, and student project presentations.
campus_video_reels.interactivity: Click to view reel in custom light-box overlay or video player.

testimonials.style: Clean white review cards with 5-star rating, verified student photo, former role -> placed DevOps role (e.g. 'Package Raised to 12 LPA'), company logo tag, and LinkedIn verify link.

floating_actions.whatsapp_button: Fixed bottom-right floating pill (`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 hover:scale-105 transition-all`)
floating_actions.call_button: Fixed bottom-left or top sticky bar phone icon for instant click-to-call (`tel:+919820012345`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Update `src/index.css` to import Plus Jakarta Sans & DM Sans fonts and set up the crisp light theme CSS variables.

Replace dark navy backgrounds (#0A192F) and terminal grids in `Hero`, `Header`, `Footer`, `CourseDetail`, and cards with clean white/slate styling (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF with #1E40AF & #2563EB blue accents).
Ensure the hero section instantly communicates 'Become a DevOps Engineer in 4 Months' with classroom + weekend batch + placement details within 5 seconds of scanning.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, enquiry form, phone call button, WhatsApp floating trigger, FAQ accordions) have precise `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT drop any existing pages or routes: Keep all 12 pages (Home, About, Courses, 6 course pages, Contact, FAQs, Privacy Policy) fully functional.
Optimize images with responsive tags and lazy loading for high PageSpeed performance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark backgrounds for hero or page wrappers unless specifically styled as a high-contrast callout block. Keep the background light (#F8FAFC).
Never use generic Inter for main headings; use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' or 'Outfit'.
Never rely on transparent dropdowns or header overlays without proper background colors or backdrop blurs.
Add data-testid attributes to every button, form input, modal trigger, card link, and sticky CTA.
Maintain strict NAP consistency across Header, Footer, Contact page, and Google Map block.
